name: The Offer
source:
A trip to buy dice turns into talk of magic, money, and the past. Will you pull Ann back into that world – or leave her out of it?

[From [url=https://gamejolt.com/games/theoffer/461448]Gamejolt[/url]]
translation:
本來只是去買骰子，不料卻聊起了魔法、金錢和往事。你會把安重新拉回那個世界，還是讓她繼續置身事外？

［取自[url=https://gamejolt.com/games/theoffer/461448]Game Jolt[/url]］
